use_cases: Creating animated text reveals on hover with character or word-level staggering
Building interactive headlines with directional animation effects
Adding motion to promotional text and landing page typography
Implementing text blur-to-sharp or scale transitions on user hover
Creating entrance animations for hero sections and marketing content
ai_summary: A Framer Motion-based text animation component that creates staggered hover effects on text content. Supports multiple animation directions (start, middle, end), various animation types (left, right, top, bottom, scale, blur), and can animate text character-by-character or word-by-word. Designed for interactive text displays where content reveals smoothly on hover.
